### Warning Fix: October 20 Loaded, Scoped Real-Group Acceptance Passed

Native `actions.py` previously forced `warning` to `auto_recall=False` and used
caller-supplied `userName`/ID labels. The fix uses a real nickname only after an
exact UID/NIM match in the account/group's authoritative complete roster.
Verified identity without a nickname sends body text only, never an opaque-ID
mention; identity conflicts still suppress sending. `auto_recall=True` schedules
twelve-second recall from an actual send receipt, without replaying old warnings.
This native fix was loaded by the full shared AstrBot restart above, not a plugin
reload. That deployment stage sent no real warning. Subsequently, owner 31846829,
receiver 43506527 and sender 23691273 reused their three online connections in
test group 1459282. `test_advertising` isolated three real warnings into two fixtures
of one and two warnings, not complete first/second/third escalation in one fixture.
The authoritative native `userNick` supplied `@大蛤` and the correct target;
`groupMemberNick=testfork` was not preferred. Independent peer records verified
original-message recall, warning delivery and warning self-recall, including
authors/operators matched to local receipts. Warning acceptance-to-recall
notifications took 12.112/12.115/12.125 seconds, not measured phone disappearance.
Rules and the receiver's original native-member role were restored; windows closed.
Formal groups, finance and normal punishment counts were unchanged, while native
receipts and minimal audit remained. Testing made zero model calls, added no NIM
connection and restarted no service. This accepts only nickname/target and warning
recall, not mute escalation, full functionality or phone rendering.
Evidence: `/opt/backups/wsl-warning-live-20261020-I5Z5qf/result.json`.
The first verifier's hash-parsing error was recovered read-only without resending;
see [isolated acceptance](wangshangliao-membership-testing.md).
The 619 passing tests precede the missing-nickname
fallback refinement, not final regression or phone acceptance. Historical audit
dates and findings remain unchanged.

Final offline regression subsequently completed in six disjoint batches:
`a-b`, `c`, `d-f`, `g-m`, `n-r`, and `s-z`. Aggregating
`/opt/backups/wsl-resume-20261020-YN7uIb/regression-{range}.xml` yields 6481 unique
cases: 6429 passed, 52 conditionally skipped, zero failures and zero errors.
File coverage exactly matches `tests/test_wangshangliao*.py` and `tests/test_wsl*.py`,
without duplicate cases. Earlier single-process runs ended with SIGTERM (exit143);
they are not passes and are excluded from this aggregate. These are offline results
only, separate from the scoped three-warning live checks above; they establish
neither group-AI/full-function acceptance nor phone rendering. Unrelated audit
findings are not resolved by this result.

After restart, the offline `actions`, `reply_recall`, `group_ai` and
`native_conversations` regressions passed another 308 tests in 14.07 seconds;
see `focused-regression.xml` in the deployment backup. Read-only native receipt
observation at deployment found zero new recall intents and zero pending recalls,
not live warning proof. Subsequent warning receipts are separate evidence and do
not rewrite that earlier zero-record snapshot.

### October 19 Source Calibration

The October 19 findings below are historical source changes and isolated tests, not proof that running services have
loaded the fixes. Native receive/execution changes require a coordinated
maintenance restart and controlled-group verification. Production groups are not
automatically enabled; historical amounts, attribution and payments are unchanged,
and no public-AI vendor-budget gate is automatically bypassed.

## Architecture

Existing signed-in accounts run in the existing AstrBot process. No separate
public worker is restored. The native adapter owns transport and upstream
execution; the plugin owns activation, group authority, rules and jobs.
The financial cashier remains a separate process.

The obsolete public-worker socket, launch/install scripts and dashboard network
fallback are retired. The authenticated, versioned `open-service` allowlist
dispatches only in-process. Legacy entry points explicitly refuse execution;
the financial cashier socket is not retired.
Retired login, independent credential-saving and global-administrator-writing
bodies are removed; compatibility entry points still explicitly refuse execution.
Activity invitation collection uses the current trusted business evidence. The
unused legacy notification-attribution converter is removed, while original
join notices, history and unknown-operation receipts remain. Existing invitation
ownership is unchanged.
The unreferenced `WangshangliaoCards.vue` and `WangshangliaoTestWindow.vue`
components are removed. Card maintenance and controlled tests remain in the
management page's `BusinessControls.vue`, with unchanged entry points and authority.
Page deployment must run the AI-control browser regression against the compiled
`index.html`, not only Vue sources. On October19 this caught and replaced an old
build missing autonomous participation and low/medium/high presets. Build and
verify separately, then replace only the HTML entry; retain guides and saved
group/AI settings.

![Current integrated architecture](/images/wangshangliao/architecture.svg)

Pausing the open service invalidates unused chat-manager change confirmations
in the same `open_store.py` transaction. Resuming requires a fresh preview.
Independently authorized dashboard recovery operations remain available.

### Source Map

| Location | Maintained responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `astrbot/core/platform/sources/wangshangliao/` | Authentication, transport, verified identity, final actions and durable messaging |
| `astrbot/builtin_stars/wangshangliao_moderation/` | Activation, rules, activities, authorization and financial interfaces; `main.py` does not instantiate the retired AI configurator |
| `dashboard/plugin-pages/wangshangliao/` | Current UI; reference JSON is static documentation, not runtime authorization |
| `docs/zh/platform/`, `docs/en/platform/` | Current bilingual guides and dated historical evidence |
| `scripts/`, `tests/` | [Classified tools](../../../scripts/README.wangshangliao.md) and regression coverage, never public business entry points |

`ai_config.py` is a refusing import-compatibility guard without the old writer.
The completed one-off merger and card test bound to a retired group are removed.
Tools still imported by tests or maintenance remain. Historical screenshots are
not authoritative substitutes for these tables and their JSON source.

The optional local `scripts/check_wsl_test_activation_live.py` supports one
real-LinXi activation message after an explicitly authorized reset. It temporarily
disables only the fixed owner's adapter through the existing dashboard, verifies
post-NIM-close evidence, uses the saved native session once, then closes temporary
NIM before restoring the original state. Durable intent prevents unknown retries;
there is no production interface, direct grant write or native-role bypass.
Shutdown evidence accepts systemd text or strict UTF-8 byte arrays, stripping
ANSI before checking the exact instance and post-disable timestamp. Explicit
`--retry-not-sent` requires the latest `not_sent / verified` attempt and empty
original outbox, rechecks the current invitation and links a new attempt without
altering the original receipt. Submitted or unknown outcomes never replay.

Verified departure notices are durable security metadata and survive test resets.
Invitation generations use production `prove_inviter`'s confirmed-departure fence,
not notification latency. An October 16, 2026 reset defect deleting that evidence
was corrected; the original three notices were restored offline from the exact
backup, recorded in
`/opt/backups/wsl-release-20261016-before/fence-recovery.json`.

Pair's `test_native` is a separate local-only primitive pinned to DaHa, the test
group and the ordinary fixture. It reuses the durable executor and guards with
3.2-second HTTP and 30-second action gaps. It does not restore retired chat mute
or register public, AI or MCP capabilities; live effects require separate evidence.

## Role Matrix

Business group managers are different from native Wangshangliao administrators.
The first inviter must be a current native owner/admin. New business-manager
grants also require a verified native owner/admin; ordinary members are excluded
from the chooser and rejected by both dashboard and chat submissions. Removal
of old grants still uses independent preview/confirmation; no native role is
automatically granted. An allowed entry still requires
current service state, verified identity, action grants, native bot privileges
and actual successful receipts.

## Activation And Lifecycle

Normal rejoining continues to preserve original management ownership. The user's
October 16, 2026 authorization to reset the old test group is a separate local
maintenance exception, not a change to automatic departure cleanup.
Only DaHa's authorization/working state in `1459282` is reset; existing audits,
retired markers, unknown receipts, LinXi's same-group state and finances remain.
Consistent backups precede version/epoch/namespace-bound, complete-row-checked
mutations. Both AstrBot and the cashier must stop to eliminate poller/cache
writes; merely disabling the plugin is insufficient.
See [controlled reset testing](wangshangliao-membership-testing.md#explicitly-authorized-existing-group-reset).
Results explicitly retain `reset_existing_group=true` and
`genuinely_new_group=false`. The `reset_complete` receipt at
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-reset-20261016/completion.json` proves that reset only.
Reinvitation has been accepted; neither activation, a genuinely new group's first
invitation nor full real acceptance follows from that receipt.

### Submission Boundaries

Authorization is rechecked after database waits, shared HTTP locks, send locks
and between message segments, immediately before submission. Pause, departure,
revocation, native-role and rule-version changes stop unsubmitted operations.
Disabling advertising cancels old advertising sanctions even if flood protection
remains enabled. Activity publication stays bound to the creator's authorization.
Permission preflight and local encoding failures are definite failures, not
uncertain sends. Only requests actually sent with an unconfirmed result become
unknown. Historical unknown operations are neither bulk-cleared nor replayed.

### Invitation Timing And Welcome Images

An invitation application can precede its actual join notification. When a
confirmed departure exists for the same account and team, the latest signed
invitation must follow it rather than being rejected solely by the 120-second
notification window. Without that evidence, the original window remains;
other accounts, teams or unconfirmed notices cannot relax it. This does not
activate a group or grant authority: the inviter must still send `开通` and pass
current identity checks.

## Capacity And Acceptance

Twenty activated account/group bindings are allowed; paused/departed activated
bindings still occupy capacity, separately from operating-group counts.
Trial20/Plus2000/Pro5000 daily shared pools reset in Asia/Shanghai and persist
across restarts. The separate site guard defaults to100000/day. One inflight request/person, 5s
spacing, two service requests and a 45s timeout prevent unlimited queues.
Supplier hard-budget verification blocks public models until confirmed; alerts
or balance are not proof, and credential/model changes invalidate confirmation.

Paid plans last30 days; trial costs at most CNY3/calendar month.
Recorded CNY134/335 income yields70% model budgets of CNY93.80/234.50.
Dashboard records actual CNY receipts, never fetches exchange rates or accepts payments.
Same-tier renewal appends30 days. Upgrade starts immediately, terminates the active
old period without proration/refund, and preserves queued prepaid renewals afterward.
Expiry falls back to trial without resetting daily usage. Legacy manager overrides
are not orders and their write endpoint is retired.

Plan queries and status pages use consistent read transactions. Existing pools do
not request writer locks; creation or verified identity merging uses a short
write transaction followed by a fresh identity-checked read. Status aggregates
pools in batches and sums site monthly cost once, never caching admission
decisions. Inflight and cooldown checks precede cost aggregation; count, cost,
authority checks and reservation still commit in one atomic write transaction.

Ledger queries retain fresh authorization and a consistent snapshot. A partial
settlement-state index reduces whole-group scans, with planner statistics
initialized for existing rows during its migration. Each displayed entry reads
its latest qualification-cycle and payment audits separately rather than all
historical payloads. Each exclusively leased read connection may reuse one paid
display page for at most thirty seconds, with at most four idle readers. Filter
or SQLite `data_version` changes invalidate it. Every hit still reads the current
identity, authority and group configuration in a new transaction, checking data
versions before and after the authority read. Future-proof visibility boundaries
expire it early; callers receive independent dictionaries. Unpaid qualification,
mutation previews and payment admission never use this display cache; invitation
and membership evidence checks remain intact. Wide rows are converted to named
dictionaries once instead of copied repeatedly.

The group-AI panel and `热群状态` list current blockers: Beijing business hours,
personal payer consent, native bot privileges, service/group pauses, model pricing
and the provider hard-budget gate. Saving a switch does not establish readiness.
Status checks make no model calls, reserve no quota and do not open any gate.
Advertising uses three recall/warning steps before progressive mutes. Flood
thresholds count one sender's five messages in three seconds, fifteen in ten seconds, or five identical
texts in thirty seconds, not whole-group volume. Content review and repeated-text
checks do not recognize image or video content.

Authenticated native images count alongside text toward the per-member
fifteen-messages-in-ten-seconds flood threshold. Five repeats in thirty seconds
still applies only to nonempty text. Images are not downloaded or OCR-analyzed;
image/video advertising content remains unsupported. Flood enforcement mutes
first and then recalls the corresponding burst.

### Lightweight Participation Roadmap

The following is a proposed design, not active behavior. It adds no MaiBot process,
planning model or automatic training.

| Idea | Fit within the current architecture | Resource and authority boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Activity-aware pacing | Keep at most64 timestamps per group for60 seconds; retain at least60s between casual attempts, use120s for busy conversation, and back off repeated silence to120/240/480/600s | Local decisions, no extra model requests; native @ retains its independent switch and per-user history with the same group persona; exclude moderated traffic |
| Topic continuity | Reuse the12-message/120s context plus one short successful bot reply and its native anchor; let expired or repeatedly silent topics go | No long-term memory or summary model; clear on pause, departure or configuration changes; only live real references may be quoted |
| Reviewed expressions | Initially reuse group knowledge and existing persona examples, manually entered and confirmed by an authorized manager | No automatic chat harvesting, cross-group sharing or global-persona overwrite; preserve capacity, version and revocation checks; candidate harvesting requires separate design and authorization |

Start with pacing and short-lived continuity, then inspect silence rates, actual
participation intervals and cost before adding expression candidates. A model decision
to remain silent still costs money; pacing should reduce unnecessary decisions,
not maximize the number of replies.

The fixed `open-service` action `test_quotes` and
`scripts/check_wsl_quotes_live.py` rehearse only group1459282 and the existing three
accounts: three originals and six quote directions, at least three seconds apart.
They reuse existing connections, grant no native roles and change no group switches.
Only an operation identifier and fixed step are accepted, never arbitrary content,
groups, accounts or methods. Both other connections must independently decode each
message and verify the original server ID, client ID and text in field301.
NIM tags29–38 are checked when returned; the platform omitted these optional
properties in the October19 live probe. Evidence records their presence separately,
without treating omission as a failed application quote. Unknown sends or missing witnesses stop
the run; repeated steps query the original result. Closing invalidates only the original
window, never a replacement. On October19, all nine live messages and six quote
directions passed independent verification by both other existing connections.
No extra native logins, group-role changes or financial writes occurred, and the
test window is closed. This is native protocol evidence, not phone-rendering
or autonomous-model acceptance.

#### Server-Owned Group Profiles

Profile, persona, credential and revision changes stop unsent calls and late replies.
Missing configurations/personas fail closed without silently switching profiles.
The budget gate currently verifies one model/credential binding; other models need
new verification. Saving profiles enables neither budget nor group AI and never
changes finances. Confirmed departure clears only that group's override, not defaults.
The editor now uses low/medium/high presets; inheritance and existing custom
numeric values remain unchanged until explicitly selected.

### Native Conversations And Traces

Configurations, personas, credentials, retrieval tokenization, logs, transcripts,
statistics and traces reuse AstrBot. Domain code retains scoped knowledge
ownership, capacity/version checks, shared financial reservations, settlement
transactions and fixed mute schedules with continuously checked authority and
receipts; those are not arbitrary agent/tool jobs.

AstrBot runs under the non-login service user with two CPU cores,
1GiB soft/2GiB hard memory and 256 tasks. Groups/platforms share its process;
disk and network are also shared. Cashier retains its separate process and
protected same-owner socket. Rollbacks never overwrite newer ledger data.

### Runtime Logs and Business Audits

The adapter and moderation plugin use AstrBot's native logging pipeline.
The standalone cashier forwards HTTP failures, asynchronous-task failures and
process startup errors over the existing same-owner, mode-0600 financial Unix
socket to AstrBot's logger, live dashboard logs and configured log file.
`/v1/diagnostics` accepts versioned fixed fields, not arbitrary log text, headers,
cookies, tokens, request URLs or tracebacks. It grants no financial permissions
and adds no public endpoint.

The sender buffers at most128 records and sends batches of at most16 off the
HTTP path; the receiver accepts at most64 records/second. Overflow is summarized.
Failed or unknown deliveries are not retried. When AstrBot is unavailable,
sanitized records fall back to the systemd journal, not another log file.
Forced process termination, kernel and systemd errors still require system logs
and cannot be guaranteed to reach the dashboard. Ledger, authorization, plan and
payment audits remain in their original databases and are never replaced or
cleared by runtime logging.

Local root-run test/maintenance CLIs should use the per-command prefix
`env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1` before importing AstrBot. It disables only
that process's initial file sinks, retaining AstrBot's same logger and console;
it is not a second logging system or a service logging change. Never set it
globally. Root-owned trace files actually blocked service startup on October 16,
2026; only the two test log files' ownership/mode0600 were repaired, preserving
failure history. Soak checks retain initial `NRestarts` and require zero increment,
not a reset failure counter.

Controlled tests already cover keywords, three warnings, 5/15/60-minute sanctions,
whole-burst flood recall, announcements, cards, group mute, minute boundaries,
lotteries and manager confirmation/revocation. The user confirmed ordinary-inviter
automatic departure; native history confirms the activation-denial reply.

The user confirmed the official mobile automatic-recall display on October 15,
2026. This is separate from manual recalls or protocol-only confirmation.
Four isolated cost calls used 15777 tokens; billing matched a 0.25 multiplier
and 0.0045556875 U charged. An `unrestricted` account is not hard-budget proof.

[Historical consolidation](wangshangliao-refactor.md) records older stages, not
current authority to use model tools or change permissions.

### Unfixed Findings From The October 20 Audit

These retain the October 20 source/isolated reproductions, not claims that incidents
occurred in production. The October 21 update records obsolete-script retirement
only; other findings remain unresolved. Prioritize P1 before wider rollout;
existing passing tests do not cover all of these failure interleavings.
The October 22 source update is recorded above. This table retains the original
round's findings and conclusions, not new reproductions or acceptance results.
The stale-group risk list and missing embedded risk-release lifecycle guard were
fixed with targeted regressions in this settlement integration; see the current
entry section and maintenance record. The table preserves the original findings
and does not close the remaining gaps.

Details are in [cashback](wangshangliao-cashback.md), [AI consolidation](wangshangliao-refactor.md)
and the [documentation index](../../wangshangliao.md).

# 隔离入群验收

## 本轮退役验收范围（未部署）

全部私信功能已从本轮源码入口移除：菜单、选群、好友自动审批与欢迎、个人知识、
客服、私信AI／管理员指引、财务聊天及图片录入。当前验收应检查私信不创建业务写入、
模型调用、回复或附件保存，历史库与未知回执仍保留；不再要求欢迎或私信收图“成功”。
保留群内真实@／可信回复名单、规则与活动，以及已有后台权限者的WebUI图文和邀请记账／结账。
普通群管理不因此获得全局后台登录权。完整[旧入口映射](wangshangliao-start.md)另见指南。
本轮未加载部署，禁言优先与防袭群仍待统一加载及完整实群验收，防袭群默认关闭。
下方所有带日期结果仅对应原轮次，不能作为本次退役已部署的证据。

同步日期：2026-10-20（北京时间）。本页区分工具能力、各轮原始证据与当前缺项；
10月15／16／19日的结论只对应当时执行，不因后续补验改写。

## 2026-10-24 真实 @ 立即禁言及中止收尾

本轮仅测试群1459282，真实@加`黑名单`已验证登记及41760分钟禁言，约2.7秒核实，
测试名单、禁言、临时权限、窗口及账号启停已恢复。后续群内真实@／可核实回复发送
`黑名单`会立即提交本群设置时长；下方10月23日“加入不立即处罚”是旧版本历史。
本轮没有另测真实回复、手机显示或未来实际到期。

固定验收夹具新增`send`，发送前刷新发送账号的完整成员映射，构造真实结构化@；
失败后关闭窗口，经只读核对使用`abort`，持久标记中止而非通过，不额外解禁未被禁言的目标。
未知成员操作、当前测试未知发送及处罚意图仍阻断，不自动重试。
原始摘要差异与已核实的未开通群目录离群变更单列审计，未回滚真实成员状态。
详见[本轮逐项证据与边界](wangshangliao-testing.md)。

## 黑名单代码加载与配置验证（2026-10-23，真实重入未测）

北京时间2026-10-23 20:02:56完整重启已加载，在线配置流程通过，本轮真实新重入／禁言未测。
该日期契约：每次可信真实重新入群直接禁言并留群，不再踢人；
加入名单不立即处罚，重复通知、添加、重启或普通发言不续封。
默认29天41760分钟，按机器人＋群配置为1..41760整分钟。
`黑名单禁言时长 N分钟`／`黑名单禁言时长 N小时`／`黑名单禁言时长 N天`，
当时曾使用私信选群流程，该入口现已退役；
后台「群管理 → 规则 → 黑名单设置」同样须预览确认。
只影响后续真实重入，不自动重设已有禁言、不追罚；普通禁言24小时上限及原权限保护不变。
离线边界、取消／撤权／切群及未知结果不重试覆盖详见[当前验收清单](wangshangliao-testing.md)，
不能把离线通过写成新真实重入已处罚。旧通知不套新时长、最后同步权限fence、
确证未提交不误记unknown三项补修已验证；真正unknown保留不重试。

旧“三踢后固定29天”→新“首次起每次重入直接禁言、时长可设”，原三踢证据保留日期，不算新规则通过。
用户「看得见」只记对应手机显示确认，不证明未来真实到期。
20:10:45测试群1459282完成在线41760→60→41760预览／提交／读回，预览不写入；
最初两次读取被普通成员权限保护409拒绝、无写入。43506527临时grant后20:11:18撤权核验、
20:11:22刷新完成；31846829始终owner、23691273未启用，无新踢人或禁言实际处罚。
20:24:00保护复核完成，其他保护面匹配，测试tenant217→220及已审计鼎峰后台并发version4／5保留；
tenants原始整体hash不全同，未覆盖或回滚正式并发修改，不宣称正式群从未变动。
本次文档更新不执行生产操作，重新生成教程／索引／PDF但不向dist同步，详见[维护记录](../../wangshangliao-maintenance.md)。
下文原历史证据保持不变。

## 2026-10-20 三账号警告限定验收

用户接好三条连接后，群`1459282`由群主`31846829`、接收机器人`43506527`、
测试发送者`23691273`复用已有原生连接，通过`test_advertising`完成3次真实警告。
两个独立fixture分别1次、2次，不是同一fixture的完整第1／2／3次升级。
原生`userNick`的`@大蛤`与目标身份核对通过，群名片`testfork`不覆盖该昵称；
原消息撤回、警告接收与自撤回均有对端证据，作者／执行人匹配本地回执。
警告发送受理至对端撤回通知分别12.112／12.115／12.125秒，不等于手机实际消失时间。
测试规则、临时原生管理员角色恢复为原普通成员，窗口关闭；
正式群、财务及正常处罚计数未变，原生回执与最小审计保留。
实测0模型调用、无额外NIM连接、未重启服务；未测禁言升级、全功能或手机画面。
首轮核验脚本误把SHA-256当JSON解析，已只读恢复第一条且未重发，原失败记录保留。
证据：`/opt/backups/wsl-warning-live-20261020-I5Z5qf/result.json`；
详细口径见[测试与验收](wangshangliao-testing.md)，不改写下文较早实测结果。

本页的邀请受控成员、移除、接受邀请、授予／撤销原生管理权限及群主转让验收流程，
只属于本地命令行测试工具，不新增生产插件入口。
生产好友删除能力已移除，测试工具也不提供好友删除。

## 固定范围

- 每次必须用 `--group` 显式指定已授权的受控测试群。`1459282` 是已有测试群，
  不代表全新首轮群；正式群 `1516387`、`1488006` 及任何已有财务规则或账本
  的群一律拒绝，不能用测试参数放行。
- `invite`、`remove` 只由已核实的原生群主 `31846829` 执行，唯一目标是
  测试机器人 `43506527`；`accept` 只由该目标账号接受本轮邀请。不能替换成
  群主、真人、任意账号或批量目标。
- 新增 `grant`、`revoke` 严格限定测试群 `1459282`，只由原生群主
  林夕（`31846829`）操作大蛤【机器人】（`43506527`）。`grant` 只允许
  `MEMBER` 到 `ADMIN`，`revoke` 只允许 `ADMIN` 到 `MEMBER`；角色不符即阻断，
  不转让群主、不修改其他成员角色，也不能扩展到新群首轮邀请范围。
- `transfer-owner` 和 `restore-owner` 是单独的本地测试动作，只允许测试群
  `1459282` 的林夕和大蛤互相转让群主，不向聊天、后台或AI开放。它们不是
  “授予管理员”的别名；仅当前真实群主能发起请求，不能自行提升普通成员。
- 业务账号和 NIM 身份必须与固定 Vault 记录一致。成员目录中唯一允许的额外
  测试成员是普通测试账号 `23691273`，它可以不在群内，但不能成为邀请执行者
  或替代目标；其他成员或不符的身份、原生角色均阻断。
- 旧工具经普通测试账号 `23691273` 重新邀请，是现行策略下的拒绝样例，不是
  成功开通证据。生产开通仍须由真实原生群主或管理员邀请，核实当前成员目录
  和真实业务邀请记录后，由邀请者发送 `开通`。
- `accept` 只能使用同一持久化邀请意图对应的、唯一且新鲜的认证业务
  `applyId`，同时匹配群、目标、真实邀请者、时间和待接受状态。不能手填任意
  邀请编号、接受其他群邀请或重发邀请；缺失、过期或冲突证据均阻断。
- 在测试中核对真实邀请人，不能把群主、审批人或通知发送者当作邀请人。
- 来源以本轮成功的业务邀请记录核验，绑定邀请编号、目标账号、群和邀请者。
  真实测试发现，重新入群后的NIM查询可能仍返回旧邀请者；与业务记录不一致时
  单独记为SDK来源未通过，不能据此归属或转移管理权。开放服务开通同样使用
  业务邀请记录；本工具不修订生产返现归属或历史账本。
- 当前成员查询也核对最新业务成员事件：旧邀请后的踢出、退群、自然入群、
  未接受邀请或同一时间的冲突记录均不能继续沿用旧邀请者。NIM仅用于差异
  核对，不作为奖励归属依据；核验不足时返回未归属。
- 原管理归属在退群重入后保留，新邀请者不能夺权。确认被踢后清理工作规则，
  重新拉入使用默认模板，不恢复已清理的规则和旧处罚。

## 入群与离群策略

- 邀请者必须是完整业务成员目录中的原生群主或管理员。仅以真实成功业务
  邀请记录识别邀请者，不使用群主、审批人、通知发送者或NIM旧邀请查询替代。
- 确认普通成员邀请时先停用，持久化退群意图后只提交一次自身退群。结果不明
  不重试；接口失败或目录暂时缺失不证明已被踢，也不触发删除。
- 来源不明、目录不完整或身份冲突时保持未开通。一次性开通码不能绕过真实
  邀请者的原生管理身份核验；来源不明的历史群需总控核对，不能直接认领。
- 机器人被撤去原生管理权限时保留配置、管理员和数据，停止处罚及相关定时
  动作。重新授权后仅执行未来动作，不补发旧处罚。
- 只有收到影响本机器人自身的原生退群／踢出通知，并由认证业务目录确认
  当前已不在群内，或本轮自身退群有成功回执且目录确认离群，才清理工作数据。
- 清理仅限当前机器人账号和该群：规则、违规计数、待执行任务、群消息内容
  和旧确认／开通码。保留原管理归属、最小审计及未知结果回执、去重标识。
  返现账本、邀请归属、金额和未结账数据不删除，也不改变其他群或机器人。
- 重启后恢复未核验离群的阻断及未完成清理；清理完成前不得重新开通。离群
  通知晚于后续入群时，以最新成员事件核对，不删除当前已重新加入的群。

后台群聊选择器与状态区域显示待核验、撤权暂停、退群结果及清理进度。
以下截图隐去了账号及群名称，只表示页面状态，不代替真实入群验收。

![群生命周期状态](./images/wangshangliao-lifecycle.png)

## 群内开通回复

群主或群管理员邀请机器人后，由邀请者在群里发送 `开通`。未开通群也会
收到本次命令的结果，不需要先和机器人私聊，也不需要单独打开群主动发言。
如果机器人已经退群，群里的命令它收不到，请群主或群管理员重新邀请。
提示直接说明未开通原因和下一步；成员身份、邀请来源和暂停限制不因此放宽。

旧好友审批与首次菜单／欢迎已退役；验收应确认不会扫描、审批或发送，不重放历史待办。

## 自动广告递进隔离验收

后台内部白名单 `test_advertising` 只绑定已有短时测试窗口，不是聊天命令，
也不提供任意路径、目标、接口或角色修改。仅限群 `1459282`，林夕为真实群主、
大蛤为真实管理员、`23691273` 为普通成员，完整目录必须恰好包含这三个账号。
测试仍须遵守现有角色变更额度和冷却；额度不足须另行确认，不自动提高。

窗口仅含 `group_rules`，最长300秒、恰好六条测试消息和一个唯一标记。
服务端固定创建 `test-advertising/<唯一标记>/moderation.sqlite3`，只隔离本轮
警告和递进禁言计数，不删除、清零或覆写原处罚历史。真实消息接收、规则判断、
原生权限检查、撤回和禁言均沿用原执行链；原生操作回执仍在原操作库。
结果不明保留占用，不因测试库缺少回执而假定未执行，也不自动重试。

窗口关闭、过期、替换，或账号、群配置及管理授权变化后，等待中的动作停止；
已返回的执行结果仍留存到原绑定测试库，不回落写入生产计数。
离线回归通过不代表手机客户端或平台实测通过。实际验收须分别留证前三次
撤回警告、5／15／60分钟递进、对端撤回通知、禁言效果及最终解禁恢复。
测试结束关闭窗口、恢复规则和原生角色，核对正式群开关及财务字段未变。

### 2026-10-19 实测补验

北京时间2026-10-19（UTC 2026-10-18），经明确授权维护重启及第二组固定
授予／回收后，已在 `1459282` 完成真实六消息补验：

- 前三条逐条撤回并发送第1／2／3次警告，没有禁言；普通测试账号独立收到
  三次警告及六条消息对应的原生撤回通知。
- 后三条分别取得5／15／60分钟禁言成功回执；每档同时核对真实禁言名单，
  确认普通测试账号处于禁言状态。每档测试后依照冷却解禁，不等待自然到期。
- 最后一次解禁后另发一条普通消息，平台接受且大蛤真实接收；该补查未增加处罚。
- 测试窗口关闭，规则和主动发送设置恢复；林夕仍为群主及唯一业务管理，大蛤
  已从临时原生管理员恢复普通成员。原警告／处罚计数及旧测试日志前缀未变。
- 相关回归1113项通过、零跳过；财务1468条字段指纹一致，两个正式群的四个
  绑定仍暂停。没有模型调用，也未解除好友审批异常暂停。

证据位于服务器受保护目录
`/opt/backups/wsl-advertising-live-20261019/`，包括 `verification.json`、
`recovery-verification.json`、独立收件及撤回回执、`pytest.xml` 和前后财务审计。
本结果只补齐自动广告递进与恢复，不代表首次开通、全部功能或生产灰度已通过，
也不是新增的手机客户端画面确认。

## 执行

以root运行下列CLI时，每条命令均使用`ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1`，
仅关闭本地CLI初始化文件接收器，不改运行服务日志。测试工具不自动停启服务；
预览也会读认证平台并写私有测试日志，不是离线模拟或无副作用检查。

以下是独立本地 CLI `scripts.wsl_test_lab` 的受控测试流程，不是已完成验收
的声明。命令中的群 ID 必须由获授权操作者提供；预览会读取认证平台状态并
保存本地预览，不提交平台写操作，也不是离线模拟。

先选择一个动作生成预览：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action invite
```

移除和接受邀请也分别预览，不能一次执行整轮：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action remove
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action accept
```

预览显示 `preview` ID 和有效期10分钟的一次性确认口令。本地独立日志位于
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab/control.sqlite3`，只保存口令哈希，不保存口令原文。
核对动作、群、执行者、唯一目标、成员和保护指纹后，使用对应预览执行：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --apply --preview <preview-id>
```

程序通过 `getpass` 隐藏输入确认口令，不把口令放入命令行参数、脚本或日志。
`--apply` 不再带 `--action` 或 `--first`；动作和范围已经绑定预览。过期、
已使用或状态已变化的预览不能执行。

结果不明时只核对已有操作：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --reconcile <attempt-id>
```

操作 ID 对应已登记的本轮预览 ID。`--reconcile` 只读取现有操作的认证结果并
更新独立本地日志，不提交新的平台写操作，不与 `--apply` 混用。

### 首轮邀请

若要检查全新群的首次邀请路径，由原生群主先在官方客户端创建受控测试群，
提供群 ID，再预览：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <fresh-testgroup> --action invite --first
```

`--first` 只适用于邀请，不要求先踢出成员，也不删除历史授权、租户或审计来
制造“首次”。除本地历史开通／审计和群退役记录外，还检查目标业务账号
`43506527` 当前返回的最新申请／邀请日志；发现该群、该目标的历史记录时
拒绝首轮路径。返回日志无匹配不等于已证明平台全部历史为空，已有群不能据此
冒充新群。没有合规全新群时停止并保留缺口。当前没有可靠核实的建群、加好友
请求结构，工具不猜测或编造这些接口。

邀请或入群结果 `verified` 只证明本轮成员操作有对应证据，不证明首次开通、
默认规则、原生权限及后续全部功能均已验收。首次完整激活还需独立的真实
邀请来源、原生身份、`开通` 结果和后续功能证据，不能从一次邀请成功推断。

2026-10-16获授权的旧群归零仅是替代测试，必须标注
`reset_existing_group=true`、`genuinely_new_group=false`。
`reset_wsl_test_group.py`默认离线预览，`--apply`要求共享AstrBot与独立结账
双服务已停止、相关数据库无人持有；工具不自行停服务。仅重置固定租户工作状态，
保留账本、授权安全边界、`departure_verified`、原始审计及未知回执。
重置完成、接受邀请、真实邀请者发送`开通`及原生管理员权限是独立证据；
不要清理历史再用`--first`冒充新群。详细维护前置条件见
[现行测试与验收](wangshangliao-testing.md)。

### 原生管理角色验收

`grant`、`revoke` 是本地隔离测试动作，其官方原生接口路由已从官方APK核实。
上述补验已有本轮授予及恢复的真实证据；单独核实路由仍不等于执行通过。
仅使用以下固定测试范围预览：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action grant
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action revoke
```

两条命令是不同角色前置条件下的独立预览，不可直接作为连续执行脚本。完整
认证成员目录必须确认 LinXi 仍是原生群主，DaHa 在群内且具有动作要求的
当前角色；这两个角色动作必须恰好包含三个固定账号，`23691273` 必须保持
普通成员角色。账号和 NIM pin 仍以固定 Vault 核对，不按显示名称授权。

每个动作均复用前述独立预览、10分钟一次性口令、`getpass` 确认和单次
`--apply --preview` 流程，受同一本地日志的锁、完成后限速、每日额度和未知
结果不重放约束。回执后还须读取认证成员目录，核对目标角色及其他成员未变。
原生角色授予不是插件管理授权，不改变生产请求白名单或生产聊天命令。

开始前记录目标原角色，结束时必须恢复并再次核对。通常为 `MEMBER` 经
`grant` 变为 `ADMIN`，再为 `revoke` 单独生成新预览、确认执行，恢复
`MEMBER`；若从 `ADMIN` 开始测试撤权，则另行预览、确认 `grant` 恢复
`ADMIN`。恢复同样消耗写额度并遵守间隔，不能为恢复绕过保护。结果不明时先
核对已有操作，不盲目反向执行或重发；无法证明已恢复时记录未完成，不宣称
测试通过。恢复角色不重放旧处罚，也不删除或重置历史管理授权。

每轮动作仍须单独留存真实结果，不能沿用上述补验代替新一轮证明。原生成功
回执和目录角色变化也不代替手机客户端的可见画面证据。

### 群主转让测试

测试禁言、撤回和活动只需要大蛤具备管理员权限，通常应使用前面的 `grant`，
不需要转让群主。确需验收群主转让时，使用两个明确分开的动作：

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action transfer-owner
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action restore-owner
```

以上只是不同前置条件下的预览，不能直接连续执行。`transfer-owner` 要求林夕
当前是群主，大蛤是成员或管理员；`restore-owner` 要求大蛤是群主，并且同一
审计库已有成功回执及完整角色核对的前向转让。转回的预览绑定原转让记录，
不接受未留证的手机端转让作为测试工具自己的成功证据。

每次预览仍须单独使用 `--apply --preview` 和隐藏输入的一次性确认，提交前
及共享HTTP锁内重新读取完整成员目录、身份和保护指纹。三个账号须全部在群、
身份正常且UID／NIM一致，第三人角色不得变化。回执和目录不一致、超时或
取消后结果不明时停止，只能核对，不自动重发或反向转回。

平台可能将原群主降为成员或管理员，工具记录实际角色，不假定转回后大蛤
仍保留原管理员权限。`role_restore_required` 为真时，须另行预览 `grant`
或 `revoke` 恢复原角色；群主转回的成功不等于整轮状态已经恢复。
转让前至少须有两次剩余写额度，为单独转回留出空间，但不会自动提交转回。
全部动作复用同一份 `/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab/control.sqlite3`，不得换库、
删计数或清历史。新增动作未执行真实转让前，不标记真实验收通过。

### 操作保护与旧入口

工具使用共享持久化日志和跨进程排他锁，并发运行失败而不是并行写入。每次
请求完成后至少等待3秒才发送下一请求；每次写操作完成后至少等待30秒才发送
下一写操作。间隔跨进程和重启保留，每个 UTC 自然日最多预留10次写操作。
CLI可显式指定 `--daily-write-limit 20`，最多二十次；它和三账号验收脚本
共享累计次数，不会重置历史，也不能任意提高上限。
仅在操作者明确批准补验时，可额外指定 `--extra-role-pair-day YYYY-MM-DD`
（当天UTC日期）追加固定测试群 `1459282` 的一组 `grant`／`revoke`：
只允许第21次授予大蛤管理员、第22次回收本次已核验授予，预留回收额度。
此参数必须同时使用 `--daily-write-limit 20`，默认只支持第一轮，不支持其他群、
邀请、移除或群主转让；不删除历史，不改变默认额度或30秒写冷却。
两个动作仍分别预览、确认并核对原生角色；不属于生产功能或平台额度。
若第二轮补验另获明确授权，可同时指定 `--extra-role-pair-round 2`，
严格限第23次授予、第24次回收；授予前必须存在当天第一轮已核验成功的回收记录。
第二轮确认绑定轮次，不能借用第一轮确认或继续第三轮；不提供任意次数上限。
写操作先持久化意图，拒绝、超时或未知结果都不自动重放。未核对完的操作
阻断新的无关写入；同轮待接受邀请只有完成上述精确核验，才允许单独预览
`accept`。不能靠换预览、删日志或重启绕过保护。

上述跨进程间隔、锁和每日额度仅约束共享这份固定本地 CLI 日志的测试进程。
独立生产运行时的平台轮询使用其他业务客户端，不共享此日志的锁和计时；
这里不保证整个账号的全部请求流都满足同一间隔，也不保证账号永不触发限流。

真实群身份、完整成员范围、固定 Vault 身份或原生角色不能核实时，在写入前
停止。执行前后核对财务字段、群规则、正式四绑定和配置保护指纹；不删除、
重置历史授权或历史财务数据。工具本身不重启服务或启用正式群；接收或执行
代码更新需要维护重启时，须另获明确授权，不能当作测试的自动步骤。

工具不注册生产 HTTP、聊天、API、AI 或 MCP 入口，不开放任意 URL、方法或
载荷。邀请和接受邀请接口不在生产请求白名单中；移除成员（`REMOVE`）已经是
正常受审查的生产 API，测试工具不扩展它的生产授权或白名单范围。新增角色
动作也不修改生产白名单或命令。独立测试状态保存在权限受限的
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab`，不靠修改生产规则完成验收。

旧 `scripts.check_wsl_integrated_live --phase membership` 普通邀请者流程已停用，
旧整轮 `--full` 也不能作为当前安全验收入口。不要继续使用旧命令，或把旧的
宽范围工作流测试描述为当前安全、全部通过的验收工具；成员操作改用上述
独立 CLI，其他旧阶段也不因此获得执行授权。

## 当前实测范围

2026-10-15 已记录的真实群 `1459282` 测试仅完成 `remove` 预览：只提交原生
只读查询，三个已知受控 UID 的角色匹配。普通测试账号 `23691273` 本轮核对的
Vault NIM pin 为 `1111308056`；运行时仍须匹配固定 Vault 身份，不能用文档
数值覆盖身份校验。本轮未提交真实移除、邀请或接受邀请写操作，相关服务 PID
未变化。这不构成真实邀请、接受邀请或首次开通通过的证据。
该段记录的是10月15日当轮范围，后续补验不覆盖或删除原始证据。

### 2026-10-19 三账号真实补验

本轮复用林夕 `31846829`、大蛤 `43506527` 和普通成员角色的受控账号
`23691273`，没有增加登录；所有原生群写操作仅作用于测试群 `1459282`。
通过测试专用预览及确认临时授予大蛤管理员，结束后独立核对已恢复普通成员。
该原生角色变更不转移插件管理归属。

- 受控普通成员通过真实群消息报名抽奖，持久化报名及中奖身份一致；
  开奖通知由另一现有连接独立接收。开始和开奖使用明确标记的后台测试控制，
  不冒称群主聊天控制、真人领奖或真实奖品发放。
- 普通成员真实禁言一分钟后，发送被平台以 `802` 拒绝；未手动解禁，
  75.95秒后禁言名单为空，原连接发送恢复并被机器人收到。

  原名恢复及逐次成员目录核对；未修改群主或大蛤名片。该项不是聊天改名片证明。
- 首次长测试名请求结果不明；保留原未知记录，随后只读核对原名仍在，
  留存人工核对记录后才为短测试名创建新的预览。没有重放旧请求，
  也未把短名成功认定为已经证明平台的长度上限。
- 当前咨询及热群人格分别完成一次真实 DeepSeek 调用，读取各自隔离测试知识；
  未向模型提供生产账本或其他用户资料，未打开公共 AI 门禁。

证据位于 `/opt/backups/wsl-real-acceptance-20261019/`、
`/opt/backups/wsl-three-live-20261019T065403Z/` 和
`/opt/backups/wsl-three-card-live/2d91ff9c4e33447cae33ecdb50d92af7/`。
正式账本和正式群开关保护摘要保持一致。已有群的补验不是新群首次开通证明，
受控机器人账号的普通成员角色也不等于真人账号。

## 尚未通过的验收

截至2026-10-20，供应商有限额度配置已有认证证据：
`/opt/backups/wsl-ai-enable-20261020T0724Z/enable.json`记录`quota_limited`及本地确认，
但`supplier_exhaustion_tested=false`，不宣称实际耗尽后拒绝已通过。另在
`/opt/backups/wsl-group-ai-20261020-format/runtime.json`记录222项相关回归及
北京时间15:47:56的群AI自动发送`accepted`，本轮没有另发群测试消息，
手机确认仍为false。默认拒绝未确认预算不等于当前运行预算未确认；
也不能为复用旧脚本而关闭已经获授权的群AI或恢复旧双账号／正式群暂停基线。

本地模拟不等于真实邀请。旧测试群重置／重入、部分原生管理与恢复通过，
不等于全新群首次邀请开通。旧欢迎原生图片仅保留历史证据，好友欢迎已退役，不再作为现行验收项；
2026-10-15已有用户确认自动撤回画面，不能因此将其他手机项目一并标为通过。
供应商额度耗尽拒绝、现行WebUI鉴权下真实登记／撤回、真实故障演练和生产配额下
持续负载仍须独立证据。用户已于北京时间2026-10-17取消旧10%查询相对增幅
上线阻断，现记录绝对P95；这不改变旧失败，也不构成持续SLA通过。
增加测试CLI、邀请成功或只读观测不能补齐上述缺项。

机器人接收手机客户端群撤回通知时，仅记录群、消息、操作人和时间等
元数据，不保存消息内容，不执行任何处罚。记录按机器人账号隔离、去重，
保留90天。手动撤回的通知不等于机器人规则撤回的客户端画面验收。

# Isolated Membership Acceptance

## Current Retirement Checks: Not Deployed

Private menus/group selection, friend approval/welcomes, personal knowledge,
support, private AI/admin guidance, finance chat and image intake are removed
from this source batch. Verify that private ingress creates no business writes,
model calls, replies or saved attachments; retain historical stores/unknown
receipts. Welcome/private-image success is no longer an active acceptance target.
Retain verified native group mention/reply lists, rules/activities, and existing
authorized operators' WebUI images and Invitation Settlement. Ordinary group
admins gain no global Dashboard login. See [the mapping](wangshangliao-start.md).
This batch is not deployed; mute-first/raid loading and complete live acceptance
remain pending, with raid defense off by default. Dated results below describe
their original rounds, not deployment of this retirement.

Synchronized October 20, 2026 (Beijing time). Tool capabilities, dated observations
and outstanding acceptance are separate. Later checks do not rewrite the original
October 15, 16 or 19 evidence.

## Native Mention Acceptance And Failed-Send Cleanup (October 24, 2026)

Only group1459282 and the three existing adapters participated. A real native
administrator sent a structured mention plus `黑名单`; one completed `command`
intent enrolled the test target and submitted41,760 minutes/29 days, accepted by
the platform and independently present in its current muted-member list. Verification
took approximately2.7 seconds. No blacklist kick occurred. The test entry was removed
through normal preview/confirmation, then separately unmuted and checked. Temporary
native roles, sending admission, windows and the two accounts' disabled states were
restored. This proves this native-mention path, not a newly tested reply path,
phone display or future actual expiry.

The previous sender relied on stale member mapping. The dedicated fixture now
refreshes the sender's complete directory before constructing the actual mention;
this run observed a mapping change. Public API acceptance and production target
protection were not broadened. Fixed `test_blacklist` operations now include `send`
and a separate `abort`. Abort requires a closed window, restored verified membership,
no target mute, no new native sanction intent and no unresolved fixture send/work.
It persists `outcome=aborted, passed=false`, performs no native cleanup mutation,
and can reconcile an expired window or plugin reload. Unrelated historical unknown
AI sends remain unchanged and are never retried.

Plugin reload preserved PID613188. The first final protection assertion did fail:
starting an existing adapter synchronized a previously departed, non-enabled group's
metadata (audit1172), changing present to0 and incrementing epoch/version. Reversing
only that audited transition in memory exactly reconstructs the original tenants
digest; all other protected rule, finance and blacklist digests match. The real
departure was retained, not reverted. Preserve both the failed raw assertion and
the later reconciliation; do not claim identical raw snapshots.
Final targeted backend regression:343 passed across four files, with one existing
audioop deprecation warning; documentation generator:5 passed. Do not add these
overlapping counts to earlier historical runs.

with at least 3.2 seconds between HTTP completions and 30 seconds between actions.
Advertisement/flood cleanup and group mute/unmute use the same local primitive.
No public endpoint, chat command, AI or MCP entry point is restored.
On October 16, 2026, 10 new tests and 58 existing related tests passed, 68 total.

## Fixed Scope

- Every invocation requires an explicitly authorized controlled test group through
  `--group`. Existing test group `1459282` is not a fresh first-invitation group.
  Formal groups `1516387` and `1488006`, and any group with financial rules or
  ledger entries, are denied regardless of test flags.
- Only verified native owner `31846829` performs `invite` and `remove`, with
  test bot `43506527` as the sole target. Only that recipient performs `accept`.
  Owners, humans, arbitrary accounts and batches cannot replace the target.
- New `grant` and `revoke` actions are strictly limited to test group `1459282`,
  with native owner LinXi (`31846829`) acting on test bot DaHa (`43506527`).
  `grant` requires `MEMBER` to `ADMIN`; `revoke` requires `ADMIN` to `MEMBER`.
  A mismatched role blocks the action. These actions cannot transfer ownership,
  change other members' roles or extend to a fresh first-invitation group.
- Separate local-only `transfer-owner` and `restore-owner` actions exchange native
  ownership only between LinXi and DaHa in1459282. They are not administrator-grant
  aliases and expose no chat, dashboard or AI control. Only the current verified
  owner may submit; an ordinary member cannot promote itself.
- Business accounts and NIM identities must match the fixed Vault identities.
  Ordinary test account `23691273` is the only optional extra roster member; it
  is not an invitation actor or an alternative target. Other members, mismatched
  identities or unexpected native roles block the operation.
- The old harness reinvited through ordinary account `23691273`. Under current
  admission policy this is a rejection case, not successful activation evidence.
  Production activation still requires a real native owner/admin inviter, current
  roster and successful business invitation evidence, then `开通` from the inviter.
- `accept` uses only the unique, fresh signed `applyId` belonging to the same
  durable invitation intent. Group, recipient, actual inviter, time and pending
  state must match. Arbitrary invitation IDs, other groups and resent invitations
  are not supported; missing, stale or conflicting evidence blocks the action.
- Native invitation attribution must identify the actual inviter.
- Original ownership survives rejoining; a new inviter gains no authority.
  A corroborated departure clears working rules. Rejoining uses the default
  template instead of restoring cleared rules or replaying old sanctions.

## Admission and Lifecycle

The actual inviter must be a current native owner/admin in the complete signed
business roster. Owners, approvers, notification senders and stale NIM inviter
queries cannot substitute for a successful business invitation record.
An ordinary inviter triggers suspension and one durably reserved self-exit
request. Unknown results are not retried. Failed reads and directory absence
alone never trigger data deletion.

Unknown invitation sources, incomplete rosters and identity conflicts remain
disabled. Activation codes do not bypass native inviter-role verification.
Unproven historical membership requires control-plane review rather than claiming
ownership with a code.

Losing native admin rights retains configuration, managers and data while
suspending sanctions and affected schedules. Regaining rights resumes future
operations only, never old pending sanctions.

Working-data cleanup requires a native self-departure notification corroborated
by signed directory absence, or an accepted self-exit receipt and directory absence.
Cleanup is limited to the exact robot account/group: rules, violation counters,
pending tasks, group message bodies and old confirmations/codes. Original manager
ownership, minimal audit, deduplication IDs and uncertain-operation receipts remain.
Financial entries, attribution, amounts and unpaid balances are never deleted.
Other groups and robot accounts are unaffected.

Unresolved departure fences and interrupted cleanup survive restart. Rediscovery
cannot reopen an unfinished cleanup. Delayed departure events are checked against
newer membership evidence before clearing a subsequently rejoined group.

The group selector and status area distinguish pending verification, missing
native rights, self-exit receipts and cleanup progress. Account and group labels
in this screenshot are redacted; it is not evidence of real invitation acceptance.

![Group lifecycle status](../../zh/platform/images/wangshangliao-lifecycle.png)

## Group Activation Replies

A group owner or native administrator invites the bot, then the inviter sends
`开通` in that group. Unopened groups receive the outcome of this specific command
without prior private chat or a proactive-send grant. Once the bot has left, it
cannot receive commands there; an owner or administrator must invite it again.
Plain-language replies do not relax identity, invitation or suspension checks.

Old friend approvals, first-use menus and welcomes are retired. Verify that they
do not scan, approve, send or replay historical pending work.

## Isolated Automatic Advertising Progression

The internal dashboard allowlist action `test_advertising` binds an existing short
test window. It is not a chat command and accepts no path, target, arbitrary method
or role change. Only group1459282 with LinXi as native owner, DaHa as native admin
and23691273 as ordinary member is eligible; the complete roster must contain
exactly those three accounts. Existing role-change budgets and pacing still apply.
Insufficient budget needs separate approval, never an automatic increase.

The original window must contain only `group_rules`, last at most300 seconds,
and admit exactly six messages bearing one unique marker. The server fixes storage
at `test-advertising/<unique-marker>/moderation.sqlite3`, isolating only this run's
warning and escalation counts without resetting or rewriting existing sanctions.
Actual ingress, rules, native authorization, recall and mute use the original
execution chain. Native operation receipts stay in their original action ledger.
Uncertain outcomes remain reserved, never inferred as unsent from an empty test
ledger and never automatically replayed.

Closing, expiring or replacing the window, changing identities, group settings
or manager authority stops unsubmitted work. Completed receipts still persist in
the originally bound test ledger without falling back to production counters.
Offline regression is not platform or mobile acceptance. Real evidence must cover
three recall warnings,5/15/60-minute escalation, peer recall notices, mute effects
and final unmute restoration. Close the window, restore rules and native roles,
and verify unchanged formal-group switches and financial fields afterward.

## Execution

For root-run CLIs, prefix every command below with
`ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1`. It disables only initial local CLI file sinks,
not the running service's logs. These tools do not stop or restart services.

The following is the controlled workflow for the separate local CLI
`scripts.wsl_test_lab`, not a claim of completed acceptance. An authorized operator
must supply the group ID. Preview reads authenticated platform state and records
a local preview without submitting a platform mutation; it is not an offline run.

Preview one selected action:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action invite
```

Removal and invitation acceptance each require their own preview, not a full-cycle
execution:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action remove
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --action accept
```

Preview displays a `preview` ID and a one-use confirmation secret valid for ten
minutes. The separate journal at `/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab/control.sqlite3` stores
only the secret's hash, not its plaintext. Review the action, group, actor, sole
target, roster and protection fingerprint before applying that preview:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --apply --preview <preview-id>
```

Enter the confirmation through the hidden `getpass` prompt, never through command
arguments, scripts or logs. Do not repeat `--action` or `--first` with `--apply`;
the preview already binds the action and scope. Expired, consumed or stale previews
cannot execute.

For an uncertain outcome, reconcile only the existing attempt:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <testgroup> --reconcile <attempt-id>
```

The attempt ID is the registered preview ID. `--reconcile` reads authenticated
evidence for that existing operation and updates only the separate local journal;
it does not submit another platform mutation and is not combined with `--apply`.

### First Invitation

For a fresh first-invitation path, the native owner must create the controlled
group in the official client and provide its ID before previewing:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group <fresh-testgroup> --action invite --first
```

`--first` applies only to invitations. It does not require a preceding removal,
and it never deletes historical authorization, tenants or audit to manufacture a
first activation. In addition to local onboarding/audit and retired-group records,
the tool checks the latest application/invitation logs currently returned for
recipient business account `43506527`. A historical record for that group and
recipient blocks this path. No match in the returned logs does not prove the
provider's entire history is empty, and an existing group cannot masquerade as
fresh. Without a suitable new group, stop and keep the acceptance gap open.
No reliable create-group or add-friend request schema has been verified, so the
tool does not guess or invent those requests.

An invitation or membership result of `verified` proves only that operation's
corroborated outcome. It does not establish first activation, default rules,
native permissions or all subsequent features. Full first activation still needs
independent evidence of the real invitation source, native roles, the `开通`
outcome and subsequent behavior; an invitation alone is insufficient.

### Explicitly Authorized Existing-Group Reset

On October 16, 2026, the user explicitly approved resetting existing controlled
group `1459282` as a substitute for testing post-reset activation. This exception
is not normal removal/rejoin behavior and does not prove a genuinely new group.
Every result must retain `reset_existing_group=true` and
`genuinely_new_group=false`. Never use `--first` to disguise this history.
Invitation source, current native roles, the inviter's `开通` command, bot
privileges and subsequent behavior still require separate evidence.

`scripts/reset_wsl_test_group.py` is a separate local-only utility pinned to bot
DaHa `43506527`, group `1459282` and manager LinXi `31846829`. Its default is a
read-only preview, with no HTTP, chat, AI or MCP entry point. It verifies current
instance/account-directory bindings, both accounts' group transport binding and
trusted identity records. Exact business account/group namespaces are mandatory;
a bare transport group number is never a cleanup predicate.
Financial configuration/history, model charges or activity reward entries for
this group refuse the reset.

First complete and verify a real removal through TestLab, then wait for persisted
departure confirmation and completed lifecycle cleanup. Applying requires both
AstrBot and the separate cashier service to be stopped, with no remaining database
holders or queued service start. Disabling only the plugin is insufficient because
adapter polls and caches may remain active. The shared-process maintenance window
affects other platforms and must be scheduled by the operator. This tool neither
stops/restarts services nor calls upstream APIs.

```sh
systemctl stop wangshangliao-cashier.service
systemctl stop astrbot.service
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.reset_wsl_test_group
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.reset_wsl_test_group \
  --apply --format-version 1 \
  --confirmation-sha256 <just-reviewed-preview-digest> \
  --output /opt/backups/<new-private-backup-directory>
```

The confirmation binds tenant version/epoch, instance/storage routing, schema and
row fingerprints, configuration and the existing reset audit chain. Any change
requires a fresh preview. SQLite writer locks protect consistent backup-API
snapshots before mutations. Expected complete row state, integrity and foreign
keys are checked before commits; tenant authorization is removed last.
Root-owned private archives and read-only receipts cannot be rewritten by the
application owner. An append-only, hash-chained database receipt is also added;
this is not a tamper-proof guarantee against a root operator.

Financial ledgers, formal groups, LinXi's same-group state, original audits,
retired markers, deduplication and uncertain-action receipts remain. Their
retention does not mean working state failed to reset. Inspect `completion.json`
after interruption: `incomplete_keep_services_stopped` requires manual review,
not an automatic snapshot restore or blind rerun. After success, the operator
restores services and separately previews invitation, acceptance and native roles.

The actual reset receipt is
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-reset-20261016/completion.json`, with `reset_complete`;
real removal evidence is
`/opt/backups/wsl-release-20261016-before/reset-membership.json`.
All 1468 financial entries and protected digest `88566f7c…` were preserved,
formal groups stayed paused and LinXi's same-group state remained. Reinvitation
has been accepted; **this reset receipt does not establish activation or subsequent
acceptance**. The reset-specific suite passed 21 tests and the subsequent full
regression passed 4267 with zero skips. These are version-specific regressions,
not complete real-platform acceptance.

A later preflight exposed three `departure_verified` notices incorrectly removed
by that reset. First observation arrived 232 seconds after the real invitation,
so the test was refused before disabling or sending. The reset plan now preserves
these original rows and reports `preserved_departure_fences`; they are security
generation barriers, not ordinary disposable working data.
During a stopped-service maintenance window, the main operator restored the three
exact business rows from the consistent original backup. Evidence is
`/opt/backups/wsl-release-20261016-before/fence-recovery.json`.
Other table hashes, finances, formal groups and configuration were unchanged;
integrity and foreign-key checks passed. The new join notice's SQLite rowid was
not overwritten and old authorization was not restored.
The activation utility now uses the production predicate: latest verified
`kick`/`leave` for the exact account/team not later than this membership's first
observation. Only when absent does it use `joined-120`; an invitation must still
postdate the authorized reset. A background-verified candidate does not bypass
identity, invitation or version checks. The two corrected utilities passed 61
focused tests with zero skips; actual activation still needs separate evidence.

If LinXi's own tenant is inactive, do not reuse an ordinary-member sender while
claiming to be LinXi. Local `scripts/check_wsl_test_activation_live.py` pins the
three identities and test group above. Default execution prints the plan; an
operator reviews before `--apply`. Completed reset, current successful invitation,
native roles, Vault identities, finances and formal-group guards are rechecked.
Only LinXi's adapter is temporarily disabled through the authenticated existing
dashboard. The completed request, stopped runtime and this operation's post-NIM-
close AstrBot diagnostic are all required before using LinXi's saved NIM session
to send exactly one real-owner `开通`. No business login, direct authorization
write, runtime proxy or sender impersonation is available.

The utility shares TestLab's lock and persistent completion-based pacing of at
least three seconds. Durable intent precedes submission; unknown results and
prior attempts never resend automatically. Temporary NIM closure precedes
restoring the original flag. Original configuration digest, other platform
states and protected data must match afterward. Benign display/refresh metadata
does not invalidate authority checks, but versions, membership and grants remain
frozen. Unproven closure or concurrent configuration changes require manual
recovery without blind overwrites. Acceptance requires actual DaHa activation for
LinXi and the missing-native-admin warning while DaHa remains a member.
The utility grants no native role and retains the existing-group reset flags.

```sh
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.check_wsl_test_activation_live
# Review scope and stop other live test drivers before applying.
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.check_wsl_test_activation_live --apply
```

An October 16, 2026 live attempt stopped at shutdown verification: systemd encoded
ANSI-bearing `MESSAGE` as a byte array, which the old parser did not decode.
The original attempt remains `not_sent / verified` with an empty sender outbox;
no activation message was sent. Strict UTF-8 byte-array decoding and ANSI removal
now preserve the original instance and post-disable timestamp checks.
After manual review, recovery may explicitly name only the latest proven-unsent,
fully restored attempt:

```sh
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.check_wsl_test_activation_live \
  --apply --retry-not-sent <reviewed-full-previous-attempt-sha256>
```

Recovery rechecks current invitation, roster, membership generation and protected
state, plus the original private receipt and empty outbox. It preserves the
original row/receipt and creates a linked new attempt and durable recovery proof.
Any submitted, unknown, rejected or un-restored historical attempt, or any
existing outbox intent, forbids replay. Never clear the journal, switch directories
or reset unknown states to bypass these guards. Without `--apply`, it still only
prints the plan. The corrected activation/reset suites passed 88 tests; read-only
review of the actual files confirmed shutdown decoding and recovery proof, not a
successful subsequent live activation.

### CLI Logging And Restart Evidence

For root-run CLIs that may import AstrBot, prefix every preview, live test and
offline regression with `env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1`. This disables only
the CLI's initial file sinks; it retains the same AstrBot logger and console
output. It does not change the running service's logging, configuration or
budgets. Do not set it globally or in systemd service configuration.

On October 16, 2026, root-run tests created application log files including
`data/logs/astrbot.trace.log`, causing repeated service startup failures with
`PermissionError`. The main operator repaired only the two root-owned test log
files to owner `astrbot`, mode0600; all platforms subsequently returned online.
Original logs and failure history remain. Soak checks capture the initial
`NRestarts` and assert no increment during observation, rather than resetting the
failure counter to claim zero restarts. Keep pre-repair and post-repair observation
evidence separate.

### Native Admin Role Acceptance

`grant` and `revoke` are local isolated test actions with native routes verified
against the official APK. The controlled recheck above includes live grant and
restoration evidence; route verification alone still does not prove execution.
Preview only this fixed test scope:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action grant
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action revoke
```

These are independent previews with different current-role requirements, not a
script to run consecutively. The complete authenticated roster must confirm that
LinXi remains the native owner and DaHa is present with the role required by the
selected action. These role actions require exactly all three fixed accounts;
`23691273` must retain its ordinary-member role. Verify accounts and NIM pins
against the fixed Vault identities, never display names.

Each action uses the separate preview, ten-minute one-use secret, hidden `getpass`
confirmation and single `--apply --preview` workflow above. The same local journal
lock, completion-based pacing, daily budget and unknown-outcome no-replay fences
apply. After a receipt, read the authenticated roster to confirm the target role
and that other members are unchanged. Native admin status is not plugin management
authorization and does not change production request whitelists or chat commands.

Record the original target role before starting and restore it at the end, then
verify again. Normally this is `MEMBER`, followed by `grant` to `ADMIN`, then a
separately previewed and confirmed `revoke` back to `MEMBER`. If testing revocation
from an original `ADMIN` role, separately preview and confirm `grant` to restore
`ADMIN`. Restoration consumes write budget and follows the same pacing; it does
not bypass safeguards. Reconcile an unknown outcome before any further action,
without blind inverse requests or replay. If restoration cannot be proven, record
the test as incomplete rather than passed. Restoring the role neither replays old
sanctions nor deletes or resets historical management authorization.

Each new run still requires its own live evidence rather than reusing the
controlled recheck above. Native acknowledgments and observed roster roles do
not replace visible evidence from the phone client.

### Native Owner Transfer Tests

Moderation and activity acceptance normally needs only administrator access:
use `grant`, not ownership transfer. For explicit owner-transfer testing, preview
the following separately; these commands are not a consecutive execution script:

```bash
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action transfer-owner
env ASTRBOT_DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=1 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.wsl_test_lab --group 1459282 --action restore-owner
```

The forward action requires LinXi to own the group and DaHa to be a member or
administrator. The return requires DaHa to own it and a verified forward attempt
with a provider acknowledgment and exact roster evidence in the same journal.
Return confirmations bind that original attempt. A transfer performed manually
in the app is not claimed as the tool's own verified forward action.

Each preview needs its own `--apply --preview` and hidden one-use confirmation.
Fresh complete membership, account/NIM identities and protected fingerprints are
checked again at submission, including inside the HTTP lock. All three accounts
must be present and healthy; the third account's role must remain unchanged.
Contradictory roles, timeout or cancellation with uncertain submission stop the
workflow. Reconcile only; never automatically replay or transfer back.

The previous owner may become a member or administrator. The actual observed
roles are retained: returning ownership does not necessarily restore DaHa's
original administrator role. A true `role_restore_required` calls for a separate
`grant` or `revoke` preview, confirmation and verification. At least two writes
must remain before a forward transfer, allowing room for a separately confirmed
return, which is never automatic. Every action uses the existing
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab/control.sqlite3`; changing journals or resetting audit
counters is not a supported way to bypass safeguards. Offline success does not
establish a live owner transfer.

### Protections And Retired Entry Point

A shared persistent journal and exclusive cross-process lock serialize the tool.
Concurrent runs fail busy instead of writing in parallel. The next request waits
at least three seconds after the previous request finishes; the next mutation
waits at least 30 seconds after the previous mutation finishes. These deadlines
survive process changes and restarts. At most ten mutations are reserved per UTC
calendar day by default. The CLI accepts explicit `--daily-write-limit 20`;
it shares cumulative attempts with the three-account runner, never resetting
history or accepting arbitrary larger limits.
An explicitly operator-approved supplemental acceptance may also specify
`--extra-role-pair-day YYYY-MM-DD` with today's UTC date and the twenty-write
limit. This permits only attempt 21 granting Dahu administrator status in fixed
test group `1459282`, then attempt 22 revoking that same verified grant. Cleanup
capacity is reserved before granting. Other groups, membership/ownership actions,
additional pairs under the default round and other dates are rejected. Both
actions still require separate previews, confirmation and native-role verification.
The default cap, thirty-second mutation cooldown and production capabilities
remain unchanged.
A separately approved second role-pair rehearsal can additionally use
`--extra-role-pair-round 2`. It permits only attempt23 to grant and24 to revoke
in the fixed test group, after the same day's first extra pair has a verified
restoration. Confirmations bind the round; a first-round confirmation cannot be
reused, a third round is rejected, and ordinary budgets/pacing remain unchanged.
Intent is persisted before mutation; rejection, timeout or unknown
results never cause automatic replay. Unresolved attempts block unrelated new
writes; a pending invitation from the same intent permits a separate `accept`
preview only after the exact checks above. New previews, deleted journals or
restarts must not be used to bypass these fences.

These cross-process deadlines, locks and daily limits apply only to test processes
sharing this fixed local CLI journal. Independent production platform polls use
separate business clients and do not share its journal lock or timing. This is
not account-wide pacing for all requests and does not promise that the account
will never be rate-limited.

Unproven group identity, complete roster, fixed Vault identities or native roles
stop the operation before mutation. Financial fields, group rules, all four formal
bindings and configuration fingerprints are checked before and after execution.
Historical authorization and financial data are not deleted or reset. Testing
does not restart services or enable formal groups. A maintenance restart required
by receive/execution code changes needs separate explicit approval; it is never
an automatic test step.

The tool exposes no production HTTP, chat, API, AI or MCP entry point and no
arbitrary URL, method or payload. Invitation and invitation-acceptance routes are
absent from the production request whitelist. Member removal (`REMOVE`) is already
a normal reviewed production API; the test tool does not extend its production
authorization or whitelist scope. The new role actions likewise do not change
production whitelists or commands. Separate test state lives in the private
`/opt/backups/wsl-test-lab` directory, without changing production rules to make a
test pass.

The old `scripts.check_wsl_integrated_live --phase membership` ordinary-inviter
workflow is disabled. Its historical `--full` path is not a current safe acceptance
entry point either. Do not reuse the old command or describe the broader legacy
harness as current, safe or fully tested. Use the separate CLI above for membership
operations; this does not authorize any other legacy phase.

## Recorded Live Scope

The real-group check recorded on October 15, 2026 completed only a `remove` preview
for group `1459282`, using native reads only and matching the roles of the three
known controlled UIDs. Ordinary test account `23691273` had verified Vault NIM pin
`1111308056` in this check; execution must still match the fixed Vault identity,
not override identity checks with a documented number. No live removal, invitation
or acceptance mutation was submitted, and service PIDs were unchanged. This does
not establish a passed real invitation, invitation acceptance or first activation.
That paragraph records the October 15 run; subsequent checks do not replace or
delete its original evidence.

### Three-Account Live Follow-Up On October 19, 2026

This run reused Linxi `31846829`, Dahu `43506527` and controlled account `23691273`
in the native ordinary-member role, without another login. Native group mutations
were restricted to test group `1459282`. Separate test previews and confirmations
temporarily granted Dahu administrator status and verified its restoration to
ordinary member afterward. Native-role changes do not transfer plugin management.

- The controlled ordinary member enrolled through a real group message. Durable
  enrollment and winner identities matched, and another existing connection
  independently received the draw notification. Start/draw used explicitly labeled
  dashboard test controls, not owner chat, real-person claiming or real prize delivery.
- A real one-minute member mute rejected sending with provider code `802`.
  Without manual unmute, the mute list was empty after 75.95 seconds; sending
  recovered and the bot received the new message through the existing connection.
- An isolated card check exercised real `CardJobs`, action dispatch and native
  HTTP: a short test card was applied and the original restored, with independent
  roster readback after each mutation. Owner and Dahu cards were unchanged. This
  is not evidence of a chat-driven card change.
- The first long-card request remained unknown. Its record was retained, the
  original card was independently read back, and an audited manual reconciliation
  preceded a new short-card preview. The old request was not replayed, and short-card
  success does not establish the provider's length limit.
- Current consultation and group personas each made one real DeepSeek call using
  their own isolated test knowledge. Production finance and other users' data were
  not provided to the model; the public AI gate remained closed.

Evidence is retained under `/opt/backups/wsl-real-acceptance-20261019/`,
`/opt/backups/wsl-three-live-20261019T065403Z/` and
`/opt/backups/wsl-three-card-live/2d91ff9c4e33447cae33ecdb50d92af7/`.
Protected finance and formal-group fingerprints were unchanged. Rechecking an
existing group does not prove first activation in a new group; a managed bot in
the native member role is not a human account.

## Outstanding Acceptance

On October 20, authenticated supplier evidence in
`/opt/backups/wsl-ai-enable-20261020T0724Z/enable.json` confirmed a finite
`quota_limited` allowance and the local budget confirmation. Supplier units remain
USD, not a conversion to local CNY budgets. `supplier_exhaustion_tested=false`:

That enablement script made no model calls.

15:47:56 Beijing time. No separate group test message was sent in this check;
platform acceptance is not independent delivery or phone rendering, and this run's
phone-confirmation field is false. An unconfirmed budget is denied by default,
but the observed runtime budget is now confirmed. Do not disable authorized group
AI or restore old two-account/formal-group-paused assumptions to satisfy a stale
test harness.

Offline tests do not prove real invitation behavior. An existing-group reset or
rejoin and the scoped native-role checks do not establish first activation in a
genuinely fresh group. Old welcome-image receipts remain historical; friend
welcomes are no longer an active acceptance target. The user confirmed automatic-recall display on
October 15; this does not accept every other phone scenario.
Supplier exhaustion refusal, current WebUI-authenticated registration/reversal,

separate evidence. On October 17 Beijing time, the user cancelled the old 10%
relative query-P95 growth release blocker; report absolute P95 instead, preserving
old failures without claiming a sustained SLA. Adding a test CLI, a successful
invitation or read-only observation does not close these gaps.

Received native mobile recall notifications are stored as account-isolated,
deduplicated metadata for 90 days, without message content or moderation actions.
An observed manual recall does not prove the bot's rule-driven recall on a phone.

# Document: 旺商聊插件参考

# 旺商聊群管

## 昵称前缀自动黑名单

服务端私有`blacklist_prefixes.json`可明确指定机器人、群、昵称前缀和7天禁言。
只匹配最新完整成员目录中的真实群昵称开头，英文字母不分大小写；
不匹配消息正文，不根据相似昵称推断多个账号属于同一人。
当前成员也会检查，可信入群通知直接唤醒检查，另有每60秒一次的补查；
使用原有有界群任务，不下载图片、不等待OCR、不踢人。
群主、管理员和机器人仍受保护，手动白名单冲突单列且不自动删除。
入黑与禁言分别留审计，同一名单周期仅提交一次前缀禁言，未知不重试；
已被平台禁言的不覆盖或续长。后续可信真实重入沿用现有黑名单流程。
只有本群黑名单时长仍为10080分钟时才执行新前缀禁言，否则暂停而不改群设置。
规则生效期间，手动移除后仍保留匹配昵称的成员可再次被纳入；需停用私有规则才能停止自动纳入，
停用不自动删黑或解禁，不影响既有原生禁言和审计。AI和群命令不编辑此私有授权。
源码实现不代表部署或真实处罚验收，另查维护记录。

## 视频转发管理入口

2026-11-13：天马`bkplayer`新增可选私有解析网关`parse.tmzyz.com`。实例目录下
`tmzyz_gateway.json`（600，仅服务账号可读）填写会员后台的播放ID与TOKEN，
可指定`carrier`（移动／电信／联通）和可选的公网`client_ip`；文件不存在时继续走公共播放器。
网关按官方`md5(PLAYER_ID + TOKEN + 资源ID)`签名，经`/api/getPlayerUrl`取mpd后由
`/api/mpd/<mpd>`取有界播放清单；不把TOKEN写进数据库、配置页、日志或错误文本。
网关拒绝、点数不足或运营商不匹配时回退公共播放器；网关清单无法按字节范围取用时也回退一次。
媒体边缘域名只接受`cmecloud.cn`、`ctyunxs.cn`、`mini189.cn`三类已核验HTTPS主机。
2026-11-13在测试群1459282实测网关取流两条：161528（127秒、624×848、27,160,475字节）
与161521（17秒、720×1280、6,320,898字节）均获平台受理，服务器历史读回资产、时长、
尺寸与摘要一致，本地缓存删除、防重保留；手机端播放仍需用户确认。

2026-11-13新增「按分类转发」：后台读取CMS分类目录，点击分类只预览该分类中的一条，
不改保存的自动发送分类，仍须确认后才上传发送。
2026-11-13真龙看片群44339.vip（1516387）启用天马分类71自动转发，每20分钟、
单条24MiB；首轮27MiB素材上传回执未知而暂停，改限后单条161431获平台受理。
2026-11-13视频转发页补充即时校验（单条1—32MiB、剩余空间1—20GiB、间隔1—1440分钟）、
分类预览不受未保存表单阻塞、`cancel_active`取消未提交预览，以及45秒准备时限和
150秒卡死巡检；分类38实测29287预览成功并取消，未发送。
2026-11-13测试群分段验证旺商聊原生视频：1.60—102.60MiB共多档均平台受理并历史读回；
118.39MiB未取得资产、126.84MiB提交未知，故硬上限调整为112MiB（不宣称平台绝对上限），
长视频时长放宽到1200秒。
2026-11-13真龙看片群改为分类38（国产自拍）／每5分钟自动发送，单条24MiB；
定时任务遇内容级跳过保留`scheduled`并在下一间隔继续，未知回执仍暂停。
后台与定时任务在原生角色证据超过60秒时先刷新成员目录，解决误报
“机器人当前群管权限尚未核实”；规则、主动发送授权和发送锁内复核保持不变。
2026-11-03：「群管理 → 视频转发」改为CMS接口、可选分类ID、自动发送及间隔。
移除Telegram来源／历史采集草稿和固定标题、标签、成人关键词筛选；新闻等CMS不受内容词拦截。
配置仅写实例私有`video-relay-control.sqlite3`，不改广告、名单、处罚、活动或财务。
`video-relay`插件接口仅允许JWT后台机器人管理权限，提供GET读取及POST预览／确认；
令牌绑定操作者、账号、群及配置版本，5分钟过期、单次使用。
不接收凭据或任意代理URL，不复用统计账号会话。旧配置默认关闭自动发送，
操作者预览确认启用后按间隔自动逐条发到当前群，同机器人串行；单条手动预览／确认保留。
过程、回执与清理状态分别显示，未知结果暂停且不重试。
2026-11-03已热加载；测试群1459282的一条5秒中性视频获平台受理，本地缓存已删除、防重保留。
本轮未启用CMS自动发送，未实测真实CMS采集或独立收件，手机封面及播放由用户确认。
随后用户反馈该条在手机显示空消息，故手机验收失败，不以平台受理认定视频可用。
视频编码补齐官方`Timestamp`后，用户确认V2也为空消息，两轮手机验收均失败。
只读对照本人12秒手机视频后，补齐旧客户端解码入口要求的紧凑`{"b":"…"}`封装；
V3中性夹具使用独立来源和摘要，旧受理回执及防重保留。
2026-11-03用户回复「正常了」，仅这条V3手机端验收通过；真实CMS和连续调度仍未验收，
未因此自动开启连续发送。
详见中英文入门教程及带日期的维护记录。

适配MacCMS的list／detail JSON与直接HTTPS MP4；天马另支持`bkplayer`固定播放器与有界fMP4范围。
保留格式、大小、HTTPS、公网DNS、防重和权限校验，不执行脚本；通用HLS／DRM／重定向暂不支持。
签名媒体地址只存在内存，不写配置、数据库或日志；取消或结束即删本地视频及封面，
清理失败显示待重试并后台恢复。持久保留bot＋group＋CMS＋来源编号与视频摘要，重启和删文件不清防重。
任务详情保留7天且最多约2048条；长期防重摘要独立保留，不存视频或聊天正文。

新增`native_video.py`：依据官方Android3.7.3的`MessageVideo`与`MediaUploadWorker`，
使用`asset_type=3/use_for=1`上传MP4与本地提取的JPEG；原片和`.jpg`读回校验摘要。
消息为`format=3/video=103`，按官方客户端保留空`screenshot`子消息、以秒填时长，
封面由原生资产ID解析，不把远端播放地址伪装成资产ID。
FFmpeg／ffprobe整理H.264／AAC MP4，单条最多112MiB、1200秒、2048px；不支持则拒绝。
`video_relay_delivery.py`串联有界下载、私有预览、单次确认和原生账本；
拒绝内网DNS、重定向和凭据转发，发送前重新核验本群规则、权限、版本和主动发送授权。
`video_relay_runtime.py`后台调度、清理及重启隔离，长上传不占用处罚HTTP锁；
一次最多一个在途／待确认视频，普通群管、广告、名单及财务配置不自动修改。
预览不上传，上传不等于发送，平台受理不等于手机播放。离线测试不能替代真实收件验收。
后台专用`preview_test_video`只为43506527／1459282生成固定中性视频，不接收文件或URL；
须再用单次令牌确认，沿用上传、原生发送、清理及防重。它只核验真实成员及主动发送授权，
不需临时提权或改广告规则，不豁免CMS的已保存群规则及原生管理员校验。
同权限GET `operation=inspect_test_video`仅只读查询这两个固定身份范围内最近10条消息，
返回本人已认证视频的脱敏结构；不下载媒体、不返回聊天正文、不回放消息或新建登录连接。

## 群内与WebUI使用规范

全部旺商聊私信功能退役，私信专属业务代码、旧菜单、业务客服和好友模块已物理删除；
私信命令、选群、数字菜单、好友自动审批与私信欢迎、个人知识、私信AI与管理员指引、
私信财务及图片录入均不再提供。群图文、群AI、活动及原账本保留。
历史会话、知识、邀请、活动、付款、账本及审计不因入口退役而删除或重算。
这是待集成源码与文档规范，不是已部署、历史数据已清理或实群／手机验收通过的声明。
普通群管理没有全局后台登录权；没有后台权限时使用本群保留命令，或请已有相应权限的负责人维护。
不得共享总控密码，也不把旧聊天财务授权或Access名单转换为后台账号。

| 旧入口 | 保留入口或处理方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 私信选群、数字菜单、私信管理命令 | 回目标群使用保留命令；已有相应后台权限者在WebUI查看使用帮助，不跨群列举或切换 |
| 群内帮助／我的权限及别名 | `帮助`、`群管帮助`、`help`／`/help`、`我的权限`、`sid`／`/sid`及原前缀写法已移除；WebUI帮助与授权管理保留 |
| 黑名单禁言时长聊天设置 | 时长设置聊天预览确认入口已移除；群管理 → 规则 → 黑名单设置及既有群时长保留 |
| 私信黑／白名单 | 群内真实@／可信回复；已有后台权限者可在群管理 → 规则维护 |
| `广告图片`私信收图、私信附件 | 群管理 → 规则 → 关键词回复与定时发言上传，无聊天收图替代 |
| 客服选择、个人知识、`/chat`、`/exit`、管理员私信指引 | 退役，不迁入群AI，不恢复旧菜单；历史只保留 |
| 私信现金查询、`结账`及付款确认 | 已有后台权限者在活动与财务 → 邀请记账／结账处理，不公开个人金额 |
| 好友审批、首次私信菜单及欢迎 | 退役，不自动同意、不发送私信通知、不重放历史待办 |
| 群管理 → 好友申请；AI服务 → 客服AI咨询／管理员指引；活动与财务 → 结算授权 | 页面与相应接口移除；邀请记账／结账保留，不恢复私信财务 |

群命令不用先加好友，绑定当前机器人和当前群。真实邀请者在群内发送`开通`，
仍须核验邀请证据与原生管理员身份；开通码不能绕过真实邀请来源。
管理动作仍须机器人原生群管及具体动作授权，发送者须具备本群业务授权；AI不能执行或代确认。
只读`排名`／`排行`供全部群员查询，不要求查询者具备管理身份，不因此授予任何管理权。

### 今日发言排行

`排名`、`排行`、`今日排名`、`今日排行`、`排行榜`、`发言排行`、`发言排行榜`
及原斜杠写法继续可用。固定展示北京时间今天的有效发言前20名，不分页；
旧`排名 2`／`排行 2`也只返回同一份前20名。
逐行格式为`1:昵称（有效发言N条）`，显示昵称和有效条数，不输出内部UID或传输ID，也不生成原生@。
按可信完整成员快照中的UID及传输身份批量核对名字，不按昵称猜身份、不逐人发HTTP请求，
不让展示补名等待审核共用的HTTP或目录刷新锁。真实数字昵称保留，缺名显示“未获取昵称”。
内部排序统计和自动白名单仍使用UID；命令及对应回复沿用原自动撤回机制。

## 名单、阈值与验收边界

广告审核开启时，单条消息超过7行（8行及以上）按广告处理，沿用原警告／禁言循环。
7行及以内不因行数命中；其他广告关键词及推广组合仍独立识别。
只统计实际换行，CRLF计一次，空行与末尾空行计入；屏幕自动折行和字面`\n`不计。
支持LF、CR、CRLF及Unicode行／段分隔符；管理员、机器人和有效白名单保护不变。
这是独立格式规则，不以联系方式、关键词或OCR为前提，引用举报与普通多行聊天也可能命中。
关闭本群广告审核则不执行此规则，不追罚历史消息；实现或离线测试不代表实群验收。

专门汇报成员可由服务端单独授予当前机器人、群及UID的**专属禁言**权限：
真实`@成员 禁言128`／`@成员 禁言 128`表示128分钟，单次1至4320整分钟（最多3天）。
例如`@成员 禁言4320`为3天；此扩展仅限已单独授权入口，普通自动处罚上限不变。
也支持`@成员 禁言30分`／`@成员 禁言30分钟`及末尾句号；
只发`@成员 禁言`会提示补全时长，不默认禁言、不转AI。
不需要@机器人，不授踢人、解禁、名单、规则、财务或后台权限；汇报名单本身不授权。
群主、管理员、机器人、自己、有效白名单及黑名单目标受保护，已有禁言不覆盖。
私有`mute_delegates.json`与`speech_report.json`取交集，缺失／无效时拒绝；
提交前重复核验授权与完整原生目录，未知不重试，不将受理当手机验收。
2026-11-05新增固定范围的连带撤回：禁言受理／核验成功后，后台逐条限速撤回
目标本群命令前30分钟的可核实消息，包括普通文字、图片、表情、视频等，不要求另判违规。
不会公开或复制正文；以原始UID、传输身份、服务端时间及接收账本共同核验，不跨群、不处理更早或命令后消息。
先禁言、后撤回，单机器人仅一批、间隔3至5秒，单批最多500条；超限或已有任务时明确报告未启动，
已受理／独立观察到的撤回跳过，拒绝或未知立即停止，不自动重试、重启续跑或延长原禁言。
每条前复核原授权及目标保护；后台原批量撤回区域查看进度或停止后续操作。
没有可靠记录、记录被清理或平台不接受时不保证“全部撤回”；源码、部署及手机验收分别记录。

简写保留原流程：`加黑`＝`黑名单`、`删黑`＝`解除黑名单`、
`加白`＝`白名单`、`删白`＝`移除白名单`。加白须真实@，
加黑／删黑须真实@或可信同群回复；删白支持真实@一人定位已有记录或按名称搜索，
两者都仍须选择并确认，不直接移除或解禁。只发删白会提示补全目标，不静默忽略。
旧指令、权限、名单互斥、时长和未知回执保护不变。

群内真实`@一名成员 白名单`直接加入，无需搜索／选择／确认；
黑名单接受真实单一@或可信同群原消息回复，登记后立即按本群时长禁言、不踢人。
`解除黑名单`（兼容`移除黑名单`）同样核验真实目标，移出名单并解禁，分别报告结果；
后台添加只登记，后台移除不自动解禁。机器人命令或后台解禁经平台核验后，
同时移除本群当前黑名单；回执未知／核验失败保留名单，分别反馈结果。
手机端解禁暂未接入可信管理员事件同步，不根据当前未禁言或自然到期自动删名单。
该联动已于2026-11-02 01:48北京时间完整重启加载，真实解禁联动尚未实群验收。
时长默认29天＝41760分钟，范围1..41760整分钟；只影响之后群内拉黑和可信真实重入，
不重设已有禁言、不追罚或重复续封。群主、管理员、机器人受保护，黑名单优先于白名单。
默认值只用于未设置的群；删除`黑名单禁言时长`聊天入口不会重置任何已保存时长。
后续修改仍由已有相应后台权限者在群管理 → 规则 → 黑名单设置预览确认。
新加名单按同bot＋group＋UID互斥，须先移除另一名单；历史重叠保留、分别移除，不自动转移或删除。
退群／改名可按当前名、保存旧名或精确UID定位已有名单，后台添加仍按当前真实目录名称搜索。

普通刷屏为同成员3秒5条、10秒15条、30秒同文5条。广告与刷屏共用每轮三次撤回警告，
随后1／3／10分钟禁言，10分钟结束后重新三次警告；失败及未知不升级，不自动踢人。
自动白名单按北京时间昨天有效文字前20名且至少101条新获资格，每30秒刷新；
同成员30秒最多一条、同文5分钟去重，最近30秒待核对，撤回文字不计。
资格跨日保留，有效文字聊天刷新7天保留期，连续7天无有效聊天退出；无需每天重新达标，
不从第21名补位，总人数可超过20。手动名单不变，明确移出须后续日期重新达标。

禁言优先与防袭群仍待统一加载和完整实群验收，不能宣称线上已生效。
防袭群默认关闭：真实新人观察10分钟，3秒3条任意消息或10秒5条媒体触发禁言10分钟；
60秒两个不同新人触发15分钟防护，只给后续新人禁言1分钟。不按昵称推断换号，
不踢人、不自动拉黑、不动普通警告；白名单和管理保护、黑名单优先不变。
重入只补已受理禁言剩余整分钟向上取整，不覆盖更长禁言；机器人成功解禁取消该次补执行，
手机直接解禁事件仍待核验，关闭／结束防护不自动解禁。未知回执保留、不重试。

## WebUI图文与群AI

已有后台权限者在群管理 → 规则上传静态JPG／PNG／WebP，原图每张不超过5MB。
关键词每条1图；定时每计划最多3图、每次1图按1→2→3→1轮换，先图后文，也可纯图。
三条错峰使用三个独立计划，默认00／20／40分、各自60分钟一次；应用时间只改草稿，
仍须启用、预览和本人确认。素材私有、按机器人和群隔离去重，不跨群复用。
正文上限2000字；图文未全部确认时暂停核对，不重发图片或已发送文字。
定时发言新增本群开关`replace_previous_ad`，默认关闭，须预览确认。
开启后同机器人同群所有计划共用上一组广告：新图和全部文案成功发出后，
逐条撤回上一组图片及分段文案；不动关键词回复或群员消息。失败／未知保留旧广告，
撤回结果单独显示和审计，未知不重试、不重启补发；首次开启不追撤历史广告。
接入器原生回执新增保留路由，须受控完整重启；源码和离线验证不代表已部署或手机通过。
关键词精确优先、其余按保存顺序只命中一条，默认同群同规则冷却30秒；
命中后即使带@、冷却或发送失败，也不回落AI。定时断线／重启不补发。

群内@、自主接话和冷场使用本账号本群配置，默认关闭，不复用退役客服或个人知识。
模型、人格、工具、主题、时段、模式和群知识由服务端维护；群管只切换已开通总开关。
本人承担群AI扣费仍须本人确认，不能由后台冒名代办；预算及原生权限不因入口变更放宽。

2026-10-28：活动创建改为网页「保存抽奖参数 → 开启活动／预约发布」，不必发送开启命令，
旧聊天命令仅保留兼容；后台也可取消活动。新网页草稿口令默认「参与抽奖」，旧口令不改写。
红包增加仅整数元与报满人数两个独立开关，默认关闭；整元从分配阶段生成、每份至少1元，
固定档位及加奖也须整元，金额精确守恒；满员模式无倒计时，满额核验后公布。
后台操作者单独记审计，不伪造群消息，权限和草稿重新校验、重复点击防重；
未知通知或结果不得取消或创建下一期绕过核对。开场通知简化，仍不自动付款。

2026-10-28：拼手气可填写人气王额外奖励，0关闭，金额在原红包总额之外追加。
本期实际领到最高随机红包的1人获得奖励；并列最高时随机选1人，无有效报名则不支出。
规则提前公开，金额随开启或预约冻结，到期一起公布；原红包、额外奖励及合计分别展示。
不改变原奖池，不自动付款或重抽未知结果；其他红包类型不加此奖，旧活动不追补。
配置步骤和截图见项目中英文入门教程，发布和实测范围另看维护记录。

2026-10-28：玩家福利抽奖可填写完整「开始时间（北京时间）」；留空维持即时发送，
最多预约未来30天。保存参数后点击网页「预约发布」，确认预约才建立持久任务。
到点重新检查群、机器人、创建者管理权限和主动发送授权，再发布并开放报名；
倒计时从发布成功起算，过时超过60秒不补发，未知回执不重放。
预约期间参数冻结，可「取消抽奖」后重新设置。固定命令支持
「抽奖开始时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm」和「抽奖开始时间 立即」，不自动付款。
